en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from his father from Ibn Abi `Umayr from Abi Ziyad al-Nahdi from `Abdullah b. Wahab from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as).
He said: For a believer, it is enough of a victory from Allah to see his enemy disobeying Allah.
